intro: Otho Moji'ko gives you a spear soaked in blood and bound with gryphon feathers. You are to take it to Aerie Peak, in the west of the Hinterlands, and drive it into the earth beside the well at the heart of the town.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Otho hands you a long, blood drenched spear, wrapped in several gryphon feathers.

You take this, mon. You take this to Aerie Peak, dead center of town by the well. You plant it! Drive it right into the ground! Show those dwarves that troll mean business! Come back when you do this. Hopefully you come back alive.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I wish I coulda been there to see the look on their faces, mon. Are they packing up their bags? Leavin' town?
You done good, friend. Real good. Otho reward you with the big mojo.
